description: This file defines the 'Each' class in the GuzzleHttp Promise namespace, providing static methods to work with collections of promises, including mapping, limiting concurrency, and ensuring all promises are fulfilled.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: Provides static methods to handle collections of promises, including mapping, limiting concurrency, and aggregating results.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a promise that is fulfilled when all promises or values in the iterable have been fulfilled or rejected, with optional fulfillment and rejection callbacks.

methods.name: ofLimit
methods.description: Creates a promise managing the iteration with a concurrency limit, handling fulfillment and rejection callbacks.

methods.name: ofLimitAll
methods.description: Creates a promise that ensures all promises are fulfilled, rejecting immediately if any promise is rejected, using specified concurrency.
